LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.title: Librarian
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.presentation_hint: Local display and audio settings apply immediately and save automatically. They do not change card effects or other players' settings.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.orb_effects_hint: Orb values, lock indicators, and tooltips remain visible.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.reduced_motion_hint: Simplify added effects and stop circle rotation, Orb bobbing, and casting gestures. Base-game animations follow the game settings.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.limit_hint: Lower this on slower computers. Extra trails are omitted; values and effects are unchanged.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.circle_hint: The three Orbs and front indicator remain visible.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.tide_block_feedback_h: Show Tide Block gains and expiration. Off by default.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.wave_hint: The Waves tooltip still shows the value when this is off.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.volume_hint: Also affected by the game's master and sound-effect volume.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.reset_hint: Restores mod language, display and audio settings. Language follows the game language. Unlocks, gameplay progress and notice history stay unchanged.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.progressive_hint: Enable normal progression without removing content already unlocked. Applies to new runs.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.all_hint: Unlock all Librarian chapters for this profile. Other characters are unaffected. This cannot undo unlocks.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.export_scope: Export runtime logs and version information only. Saves and screenshots are excluded. Nothing is uploaded automatically.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.language_hint: Choose the Librarian's language. Detected from the game once on first use; later changes are saved separately.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.language_reload_hint: Reload added or edited translation files. Missing entries use the bundled English text.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.language_templates_hi: Export the bundled Chinese and English files as a starting point for a new translation. Existing templates are preserved.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.language_save_failed: Could not save the language selection. It applies only for this session.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.preferences_load_fail: Could not read settings. Defaults are in use; the original file has been preserved.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.preferences_save_fail: Could not save settings. Changes apply only for this session.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.logs_unreadable: No runtime log could be read.
LIBRARIAN_UPDATE.body:
[b][gold]Subscribe to and enable BOTH BaseLib + RitsuLib[/gold][/b]
Use Steam Workshop below for their links.

[b][gold]QQ group: 1091648383[/gold][/b]
Current version: [gold]v{Version}[/gold]

Seven timeline chapters now include Chinese and English stories with original art. Unlock them as your character progresses.

Open [gold]RitsuLib[/gold] at the main menu's top-right, then select Librarian for mod settings.

OK closes this notice. Don't show again stops this version's automatic notices on this computer.

Feedback: {Email}
LIBRARIAN_REVIEW.body:
You have defeated the Architect as the Librarian for the first time. Thank you for seeing its journey through!

If you enjoyed the adventure, please consider giving the mod a positive rating on this version's Workshop page. Your support helps others discover the Librarian.

Current version: [gold]v{Version}[/gold]

Suggestions and bug reports:
QQ community group: {QQGroup}
{Email}

LIBRARIAN_UNLOCK.body: Unlock Librarian cards, relics, and potions as you play, or unlock all mod content now? This choice only affects Librarian content for the current profile.
LIBRARIAN_UNLOCK.upgradeBody: Unlock all Librarian cards, relics, and potions for this profile now? Existing progress is preserved. Other characters are unaffected.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.locked_orb_display_hi: Locked orbs show remaining turns as red negative numbers by default: −1 means locked for 1 turn. You can also use the old turn display, or keep the value in the center with turns below. The display mode does not change lock rules.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.replay_welcome_hint: Clear Don't show again for this version and display the notice after returning to the main menu.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.preview_review_hint: Preview after returning to the main menu. Does not record a victory or use the first reminder.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.reload_presentation_h: Read your saved local options again. Unlock progress is unchanged.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.notice_queued: Welcome notice queued. Close settings and return to the main menu to view it.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.review_queued: Review preview queued. Close settings and return to the main menu to view it.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.notice_menu_required: Open RitsuLib settings from the main menu to use this button.
LIBRARIAN_MOD.name: Librarian
LIBRARIAN_MOD.description: An original character: the Librarian. Includes 91 active cards, 9 relics, and 3 potions, with multiplayer cards and custom artwork and effects.
